# Add Footer - Pull Request

## Description
This PR adds a professional footer section to the website with HTML structure and responsive CSS styling.

## Related Issue
Closes #1

## Changes Made
- ✅ Created `footer.html` with footer structure including About, Contact, and Social Links sections
- ✅ Created `footer-styles.css` with professional dark theme styling
- ✅ Implemented responsive design for mobile devices
- ✅ Added hover effects on social media links

## Type of Change
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

## How to Test
1. Open `footer.html` in a web browser
2. Verify the footer displays correctly with all three sections
3. Test responsive design by resizing the browser window
4. Hover over social media links to see the hover effect
